description: Defines the CheckedNumeric template class for safe numeric operations with range checking, including arithmetic operators, conversions, and validation methods.

classes.name: CheckedNumeric
classes.description: A template class providing safe numeric operations with range validation and arithmetic operator overloading.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current CheckedNumeric value is valid and within range.

methods.name: AssignIfValid
methods.description: Assigns the value to a result pointer if valid, returns success status.

methods.name: ValueOrDie
methods.description: Returns the value or crashes if invalid.

methods.name: ValueOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the value or a default if invalid.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts to a different numeric type.

methods.name: Max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of the current value and a given value.

methods.name: Min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of the current value and a given value.
